Let (f) be an infinite recursion.  Now consider the following:
(3)
;3 undef fn
;bkpt undef
(f)
;3 undef fn
;pdl-overflow
Why is the undef fn message repeated?  And why doesn't pdl-overflow
do (in effect) a ^X like other errors within errors?
